_about: Currencies a Stripe buy link may be priced in (P6), and Stripe's minimum charge in each, in minor units (docs.stripe.com/currencies, minimum and maximum charge amounts). Read by server/offers/stripeOffer.mjs and src/lib/offers.ts. Only currencies whose minor unit is the same for us and for Stripe's API: HUF and ISK are left out (Stripe takes them with two decimals while we keep them whole), as are Stripe's other zero-decimal currencies except JPY.
